Today, the name can be found in various forms throughout the English-speaking world and has even gained popularity in Scotland and Ireland due to historical ties between these countries and England. Barkley is also the name of several prominent individuals in history, including Thomas Barkley, an English theologian and scholar, and Barkley Martin, a pioneer American designer who was known for his colorful western-style hats.
